The probe loaded https://meyerbrothersgrain.com/cash-bids/ in the runner's Chromium and read the response that page's own widget asked api.bushelpowered.com for: 6 row(s) at this location, commodities Corn, Soybeans. locationId is the location UUID the payload itself carries, which is the only thing that identifies a Bushel location -- and the reason the sharded sweep could never supply it: discover.mjs keys a Bushel response on its last path segment, which is "GetBidsList" for every operator alive. cashRounding is MEASURED, not guessed: floor-cent explains ALL 6 rows, residuals -0.5c, 0c. bands are DEFAULT_BANDS values from lib/board.mjs, copied, for the commodities this location actually quotes. The hrw/hrs/sww entries were added to DEFAULT_BANDS earlier tonight after 47 wheat rows across the DTN probe were found to match no band at all and were being silently withheld. state is WI, and lat/lon are copied from known-elevators.json for Elk Mound, WI. Town precision, not street.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the same feed their own website reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
